text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: The first crown of three.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф takes a second to savor
the
moment, then raises a finger high for
all to see.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
The loudest cheer of the day resounds in
my
ears—a fitting reaction to the start of
a new
legend.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I did it, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: Congrats! Only two more to go!

text_block_list.text:
Haha... I see you're already looking
ahead.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: We'll take the Japanese Derby by storm.

text_block_list.text: Indeed we will!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And so we set our sights on our next
goal: the
Japanese Derby. But at that
moment...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Knock, knock...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Come in.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Good afternoon, President.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Sorry to bother you...
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text: Ah, you two. Right on time.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If I may ask, what did you think of my

performance?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Feel free to be as frank as you wish.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You were... unstoppable. Every bit the
racer I
thought you were...
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text:
Every bit the racer who inspired me to
join the
council. You were so strong, I
don't know how
anyone else could touch
you.
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your candor. And let me
swear to you
here and now...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I will become stronger still. Strong
enough for you
to rely on without
hesitation.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: President?
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text:
I apologize for not seeing your troubles
sooner. A
sign that I must pay closer
attention to those
around me, no doubt.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If you want to become stronger, I will
happily
guide you. I don't want you to
suffer in silence.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
B-but you're so busy! I couldn't
possibly...
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text:
It's no burden at all. I would be honored
to help
you flourish.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
So I ask you to give me one more
chance...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And trust that I am strong enough to
carry you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Why are you being so kind to... to a
waste of
space like me?
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text:
Because you are the purest incarnation
of my
dream.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I have charged myself with building a
world where
all Umamusume can live in
bliss.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And you joined the student council in
the hopes
of growing as a person.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I will not watch you give in before you
realize
your dream.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Please, don't call yourself a waste of
space. If you
are struggling to find your
way, I will help you
find it.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If you look up to me as much as you say,
can you
trust me to lead you in the right
direction?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: President...
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text: I'm sorry I've been acting so scared. I... Sniff... I'll follow you wherever you lead me...
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't cry. I'm delighted to
see you've
found your resolve.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It looks like the issue at hand has been
resolved.
Rudolf has a knack for leading
through
strength—a tactic befitting an
Emperor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But such strength requires the
determination to
carry an enormous
amount of responsibility on
her
shoulders. And in that sense, her
approach
is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ridiculous.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув watches from a distance, a
hint of
frustration in her eyes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
